subject: literacy
concept: Recognizing common persuasive techniques (emotional appeal, repetition, loaded language)
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student identifies which persuasive technique is being used in a series of short spoken examples
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a labeled technique to the sentence that demonstrates it
exercise.abstract: Student names the persuasive technique used in a sentence from a passage

misconception_flags: confuses emotional appeal with a factual claim

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
